citation: Feng, H., Jia, Y., Zhou, S., Chen, H., & Huang, T. (2023). A Dataset of Service Time and Related Patient Characteristics from an Outpatient Clinic. Data, 8(3), 47.
transformation: Authors' cleaned Data.csv: ServTime seconds / 60; sorted ascending; all other columns discarded; no additional filtering.
source_cleaning: Published Data_process_stat.ipynb retains ServTime between 180 and 3600 seconds inclusive and nonmissing Visit.No.
limitations: Duration estimates, not stopwatch measurements. No clinic-arrival timestamps used. Hybrid arrivals and doctor availability are synthetic assumptions. Uniform resampling ignores session/patient heterogeneity. Not clinical validation.
